info.name: Stannp Direct Mail Groups API
info.description:
REST API for programmatically sending physical letters and postcards, managing recipient groups, configuring campaigns, triggering individual mail pieces, and tracking delivery status through webhooks and event callbacks. Authentication uses API key-based HTTP Basic Auth over HTTPS.

Contact Support:
 Name: Stannp Support
